name: confessions
author: Antigravity
description: Anonymous confessions with numbered Components-v2 cards, optional threads, anonymous replies, and hash-based moderation that never exposes author identity.
end_user_data_statement: Stores cryptographic one-way hashes of author IDs per guild for moderation purposes (banning abusers, managing replies) without storing plaintext user identities. Author mappings can be purged via GDPR deletion.
